description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'BuzzFeedAPITest' for testing the 'BuzzFeedAPI' class in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup routines, data providers, and test methods for various API endpoints related to Buzz feeds.

classes.name: BuzzFeedAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the BuzzFeedAPI class methods such as getAll, create, delete, and their validation rules. Extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase and uses data providers for parameterized tests.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test data before the test class runs, populating fixtures for DataGroupPermission.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the getAll method of BuzzFeedAPI with different test case parameters provided by dataProviderForTestGetAll.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing the getAll method, sourcing data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests that calling create() on BuzzFeedAPI throws a NotImplemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests that getValidationRuleForCreate() method throws a NotImplemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that delete() method throws a NotImplemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that getValidationRuleForDelete() method throws a NotImplemented exception.
